text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed up by 0.2 percent in heavier trade, boosted by exchanges on lease firm Tunisie-Leasing, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 496.60 from 495.62 on Thursday.

Total volume was 2.325 million dinars against 753,355 dinars. Turnover on the first market was 2.325 million dinars mainly with the exchange of 53,956 shares of Tunisie-Leasing at the unchanged price of 32 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 1.08 dinar to 37.3 dinars. Coca and beer bottler SFBT fell 0.7 dinar to 89.5 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air edged higher 0.04 dinar to 23.2 dinars. -- Tunis newsroom 2161-787538
